package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_restrict_member_domains_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Domain Restricted Sharing Constraint (constraints/iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains) (Tier-2 • Profile G)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.list_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure list_policy.allowed_values for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Uniform Bucket-Level Access Across the Entire Organization Hierarchy (Tier-2 • Profile H)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Resource Manager within Decoupled Enterprise Event Mesh & Cloud Pub/Sub Hardening. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.

architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress]
    group messaging(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Enterprise Mesh]
    group telemetry(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Observability & Audit]

    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor Protection] in ingress
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in ingress

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub KMS-Encrypted Topic] in messaging
    service svc(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Resource Manager] in messaging
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager Envelope] in messaging

    service dlp(logos:gcp-dlp)[Cloud DLP Automatic Inspection] in telemetry
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Metrics] in telemetry
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM Ingestion] in telemetry

    arm:B --> T:ps
    iam:R --> L:ps
    ps:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    svc:R --> L:dlp
    dlp:R --> L:mon
    mon:B --> T:chr

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_uniform_bucket_level_access_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Uniform Bucket-Level Access Across the Entire Organization Hierarchy (Tier-2 • Profile H)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.boolean_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure boolean_policy.enforced for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_disable_default_sa_grants_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Disable Default Service Account Automatic Role Grants on Project Creation (Tier-2 • Profile I)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.boolean_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure boolean_policy.enforced for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Restrict Permitted Google Cloud Resource Locations to Approved Geographic Regions (Tier-2 • Profile J)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Resource Manager within Hardened GKE Autopilot & Binary Authorization Ingress Pipeline. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor & Gateway API]
    group cluster(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Enterprise Autopilot Cluster]
    group supply(logos:gcp-artifact)[Supply Chain & Key Store]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Private DNS] in ingress
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor ML WAF] in ingress
    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[Private Service Connect] in ingress

    service gke(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Shielded Nodes] in cluster
    service svc(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Resource Manager] in cluster
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in cluster

    service art(logos:gcp-artifact)[Artifact Registry & Sigstore] in supply
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager] in supply
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Container Threat Detection] in supply

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:psc
    psc:B --> T:gke
    gke:R --> L:svc
    iam:B --> T:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    gke:R --> L:art
    art:R --> L:scc

opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_require_shielded_vm_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Shielded VM Policies Org-Wide (Secure Boot and vTPM) (Tier-2 • Profile K)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.boolean_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure boolean_policy.enforced for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Restrict Public IP Creation on Compute Engine Virtual Machines (Tier-2 • Profile L)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Resource Manager within Serverless Event-Driven Pipeline & Workload Identity Federation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.

architecture-beta
    group gateway(logos:gcp-armor)[API Gateway & Cloud Armor]
    group compute(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Serverless Secure Sandbox]
    group event(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub & Dead-Letter Hub]

    service gw(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor Edge Guard] in gateway
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity Pool] in gateway

    service cr(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Cloud Run Secure Container] in compute
    service svc(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Resource Manager] in compute
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager Vault] in compute

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Encrypted Topic] in event
    service dlp(logos:gcp-dlp)[Cloud DLP Redaction] in event
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Dashboard] in event

    gw:B --> T:cr
    iam:R --> L:cr
    cr:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    svc:R --> L:ps
    ps:R --> L:dlp
    cr:B --> T:mon

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_restrict_vm_external_ip_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict Public IP Creation on Compute Engine Virtual Machines (Tier-2 • Profile L)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.list_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure list_policy.denied_values for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_restrict_member_domains_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Domain Restricted Sharing Constraint (constraints/iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains) (Tier-3 • Profile M)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.list_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure list_policy.allowed_values for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Uniform Bucket-Level Access Across the Entire Organization Hierarchy (Tier-3 • Profile N)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Resource Manager within Data Perimeter & Private Service Connect (PSC) Architecture. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.

architecture-beta
    group auth(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access & Org Policy]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[Private Service Connect Enclave]
    group audit(logos:gcp-logging)[Centralized Audit & SIEM Sink]

    service caa(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access] in auth
    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Constraint] in auth

    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[PSC Endpoint Endpoint] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Resource Manager] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Cloud Logging Log Bucket] in audit
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Enterprise SIEM] in audit
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Continuous Compliance] in audit

    caa:R --> L:org

    psc:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    svc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:scc

opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_uniform_bucket_level_access_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Uniform Bucket-Level Access Across the Entire Organization Hierarchy (Tier-3 • Profile N)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.boolean_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure boolean_policy.enforced for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Disable Default Service Account Automatic Role Grants on Project Creation (Tier-3 • Profile O)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Resource Manager within Cloud Security Command Center (SCC) & Automated Incident Remediation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group detect(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Threat & Misconfig Discovery]
    group event(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Security Notification Bus]
    group remediate(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Automated Eventarc Remediation]

    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Premium Finding Engine] in detect
    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Audit Log Realtime Stream] in detect
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Detection Engine] in detect

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Security Notification Topic] in event
    service cr(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Cloud Run Remediation Handler] in event
    service svc(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Resource Manager] in event

    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Enforcer] in remediate
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Key Rotation] in remediate
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Monitoring Alert Channel] in remediate

    scc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:ps
    ps:R --> L:cr
    cr:B --> T:org
    org:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    cr:R --> L:mon

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_disable_default_sa_grants_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Disable Default Service Account Automatic Role Grants on Project Creation (Tier-3 • Profile O)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.boolean_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure boolean_policy.enforced for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_resource_locations_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict Permitted Google Cloud Resource Locations to Approved Geographic Regions (Tier-3 • Profile P)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.list_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure list_policy.allowed_values for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Shielded VM Policies Org-Wide (Secure Boot and vTPM) (Tier-3 • Profile Q)
compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Resource Manager within Zero Trust BeyondCorp Ingress & VPC-SC Perimeter Defense. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0.

architecture-beta
    group edge(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress Tier]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[VPC-SC Trust Boundary Enclave]
    group sec(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Posture & SIEM Tier]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Zone] in edge
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor WAF] in edge
    service iap(logos:gcp-iap)[Identity-Aware Proxy] in edge

    service vpcnet(logos:gcp-vpc)[Hierarchical Firewall] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Resource Manager] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Aggregated Audit Sink] in sec
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Command Center] in sec
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM] in sec

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:iap
    iap:B --> T:vpcnet
    vpcnet:R --> L:svc
    svc:R --> L:kms
    svc:B --> T:log
    log:R --> L:scc
    scc:R --> L:chr

opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_require_shielded_vm_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Shielded VM Policies Org-Wide (Secure Boot and vTPM) (Tier-3 • Profile Q)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.boolean_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure boolean_policy.enforced for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Restrict Public IP Creation on Compute Engine Virtual Machines (Tier-3 • Profile R)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Resource Manager within Hardened GKE Autopilot & Binary Authorization Ingress Pipeline. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor & Gateway API]
    group cluster(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Enterprise Autopilot Cluster]
    group supply(logos:gcp-artifact)[Supply Chain & Key Store]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Private DNS] in ingress
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor ML WAF] in ingress
    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[Private Service Connect] in ingress

    service gke(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Shielded Nodes] in cluster
    service svc(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Resource Manager] in cluster
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in cluster

    service art(logos:gcp-artifact)[Artifact Registry & Sigstore] in supply
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager] in supply
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Container Threat Detection] in supply

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:psc
    psc:B --> T:gke
    gke:R --> L:svc
    iam:B --> T:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    gke:R --> L:art
    art:R --> L:scc

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_restrict_vm_external_ip_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict Public IP Creation on Compute Engine Virtual Machines (Tier-3 • Profile R)

  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure list_policy.denied_values for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_restrict_member_domains_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Domain Restricted Sharing Constraint (constraints/iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains) (Tier-4 • Profile S)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.list_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure list_policy.allowed_values for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_uniform_bucket_level_access_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Uniform Bucket-Level Access Across the Entire Organization Hierarchy (Tier-4 • Profile T)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.boolean_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure boolean_policy.enforced for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_disable_default_sa_grants_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Disable Default Service Account Automatic Role Grants on Project Creation (Tier-4 • Profile U)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.boolean_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure boolean_policy.enforced for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_resource_locations_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict Permitted Google Cloud Resource Locations to Approved Geographic Regions (Tier-4 • Profile V)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.list_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure list_policy.allowed_values for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Shielded VM Policies Org-Wide (Secure Boot and vTPM) (Tier-4 • Profile W)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Resource Manager within Cloud Security Command Center (SCC) & Automated Incident Remediation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.

architecture-beta
    group detect(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Threat & Misconfig Discovery]
    group event(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Security Notification Bus]
    group remediate(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Automated Eventarc Remediation]

    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Premium Finding Engine] in detect
    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Audit Log Realtime Stream] in detect
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Detection Engine] in detect

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Security Notification Topic] in event
    service cr(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Cloud Run Remediation Handler] in event
    service svc(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Resource Manager] in event

    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Enforcer] in remediate
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Key Rotation] in remediate
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Monitoring Alert Channel] in remediate

    scc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:ps
    ps:R --> L:cr
    cr:B --> T:org
    org:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    cr:R --> L:mon

opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_require_shielded_vm_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Shielded VM Policies Org-Wide (Secure Boot and vTPM) (Tier-4 • Profile W)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.boolean_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure boolean_policy.enforced for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Restrict Public IP Creation on Compute Engine Virtual Machines (Tier-4 • Profile X)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Resource Manager within Decoupled Enterprise Event Mesh & Cloud Pub/Sub Hardening. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.

architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress]
    group messaging(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Enterprise Mesh]
    group telemetry(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Observability & Audit]

    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor Protection] in ingress
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in ingress

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub KMS-Encrypted Topic] in messaging
    service svc(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Resource Manager] in messaging
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager Envelope] in messaging

    service dlp(logos:gcp-dlp)[Cloud DLP Automatic Inspection] in telemetry
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Metrics] in telemetry
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM Ingestion] in telemetry

    arm:B --> T:ps
    iam:R --> L:ps
    ps:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    svc:R --> L:dlp
    dlp:R --> L:mon
    mon:B --> T:chr

default allow = false

deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.list_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure list_policy.denied_values for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}

opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_restrict_member_domains_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Domain Restricted Sharing Constraint (constraints/iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains) (Tier-5 • Profile Y)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.list_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure list_policy.allowed_values for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Uniform Bucket-Level Access Across the Entire Organization Hierarchy (Tier-5 • Profile Z)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Resource Manager within Hardened GKE Autopilot & Binary Authorization Ingress Pipeline. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor & Gateway API]
    group cluster(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Enterprise Autopilot Cluster]
    group supply(logos:gcp-artifact)[Supply Chain & Key Store]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Private DNS] in ingress
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor ML WAF] in ingress
    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[Private Service Connect] in ingress

    service gke(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Shielded Nodes] in cluster
    service svc(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Resource Manager] in cluster
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in cluster

    service art(logos:gcp-artifact)[Artifact Registry & Sigstore] in supply
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager] in supply
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Container Threat Detection] in supply

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:psc
    psc:B --> T:gke
    gke:R --> L:svc
    iam:B --> T:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    gke:R --> L:art
    art:R --> L:scc
opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_uniform_bucket_level_access_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Uniform Bucket-Level Access Across the Entire Organization Hierarchy (Tier-5 • Profile Z)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.boolean_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure boolean_policy.enforced for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Disable Default Service Account Automatic Role Grants on Project Creation (Tier-5 • Profile A)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Resource Manager within Mission-Critical Multi-Region Failover & Immutable Cloud Storage. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.

architecture-beta
    group routing(logos:gcp-armor)[Global Anycast External ALB]
    group region(logos:gcp-vpc)[Dual-Region Workload Enclave]
    group dr(logos:gcp-gcs)[Immutable Disaster Recovery Vault]

    service alb(logos:gcp-armor)[Global Cloud Load Balancing] in routing
    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Health Checks] in routing

    service prm(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Primary Service Instance] in region
    service stb(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Secondary Failover Replica] in region
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Dual-Region Key] in region

    service gcs(logos:gcp-gcs)[Immutable Bucket Lock] in dr
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Alert] in dr
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Incident SOAR] in dr

    alb:B --> T:prm
    dns:R --> L:alb
    prm:R --> L:stb
    prm:B --> T:kms
    stb:B --> T:kms
    prm:B --> T:gcs
    prm:R --> L:mon
    mon:R --> L:chr

opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_disable_default_sa_grants_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Disable Default Service Account Automatic Role Grants on Project Creation (Tier-5 • Profile A)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.boolean_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure boolean_policy.enforced for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Restrict Permitted Google Cloud Resource Locations to Approved Geographic Regions (Tier-5 • Profile B)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Resource Manager within Serverless Event-Driven Pipeline & Workload Identity Federation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.

    group compute(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Serverless Secure Sandbox]

    iam:R --> L:cr
    cr:R --> L:svc

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_resource_locations_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict Permitted Google Cloud Resource Locations to Approved Geographic Regions (Tier-5 • Profile B)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.list_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure list_policy.allowed_values for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_require_shielded_vm_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Shielded VM Policies Org-Wide (Secure Boot and vTPM) (Tier-5 • Profile C)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.boolean_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure boolean_policy.enforced for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Restrict Public IP Creation on Compute Engine Virtual Machines (Tier-5 • Profile D)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Resource Manager within Data Perimeter & Private Service Connect (PSC) Architecture. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.

architecture-beta
    group auth(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access & Org Policy]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[Private Service Connect Enclave]
    group audit(logos:gcp-logging)[Centralized Audit & SIEM Sink]

    service caa(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access] in auth
    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Constraint] in auth

    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[PSC Endpoint Endpoint] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Resource Manager] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Cloud Logging Log Bucket] in audit
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Enterprise SIEM] in audit
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Continuous Compliance] in audit

    caa:R --> L:org
    org:B --> T:psc
    psc:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    svc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:scc

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_restrict_vm_external_ip_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict Public IP Creation on Compute Engine Virtual Machines (Tier-5 • Profile D)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.list_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure list_policy.denied_values for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Domain Restricted Sharing Constraint (constraints/iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains) (Tier-6 • Profile E)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Resource Manager within Cloud Security Command Center (SCC) & Automated Incident Remediation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.

architecture-beta
    group detect(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Threat & Misconfig Discovery]
    group event(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Security Notification Bus]
    group remediate(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Automated Eventarc Remediation]

    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Premium Finding Engine] in detect
    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Audit Log Realtime Stream] in detect
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Detection Engine] in detect

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Security Notification Topic] in event
    service cr(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Cloud Run Remediation Handler] in event
    service svc(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Resource Manager] in event

    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Enforcer] in remediate
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Key Rotation] in remediate
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Monitoring Alert Channel] in remediate

    scc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:ps
    ps:R --> L:cr
    cr:B --> T:org
    org:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    cr:R --> L:mon

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_restrict_member_domains_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Domain Restricted Sharing Constraint (constraints/iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains) (Tier-6 • Profile E)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.list_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure list_policy.allowed_values for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Uniform Bucket-Level Access Across the Entire Organization Hierarchy (Tier-6 • Profile F)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Resource Manager within Decoupled Enterprise Event Mesh & Cloud Pub/Sub Hardening. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.

    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in ingress

    dlp:R --> L:mon

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_uniform_bucket_level_access_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Uniform Bucket-Level Access Across the Entire Organization Hierarchy (Tier-6 • Profile F)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.boolean_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure boolean_policy.enforced for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_disable_default_sa_grants_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Disable Default Service Account Automatic Role Grants on Project Creation (Tier-6 • Profile G)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.boolean_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure boolean_policy.enforced for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}

deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.list_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure list_policy.allowed_values for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Shielded VM Policies Org-Wide (Secure Boot and vTPM) (Tier-6 • Profile I)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Resource Manager within Mission-Critical Multi-Region Failover & Immutable Cloud Storage. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group routing(logos:gcp-armor)[Global Anycast External ALB]
    group region(logos:gcp-vpc)[Dual-Region Workload Enclave]
    group dr(logos:gcp-gcs)[Immutable Disaster Recovery Vault]

    service alb(logos:gcp-armor)[Global Cloud Load Balancing] in routing
    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Health Checks] in routing

    service prm(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Primary Service Instance] in region
    service stb(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Secondary Failover Replica] in region
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Dual-Region Key] in region

    service gcs(logos:gcp-gcs)[Immutable Bucket Lock] in dr
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Alert] in dr
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Incident SOAR] in dr

    alb:B --> T:prm
    dns:R --> L:alb
    prm:R --> L:stb
    prm:B --> T:kms
    stb:B --> T:kms
    prm:B --> T:gcs
    prm:R --> L:mon
    mon:R --> L:chr

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_require_shielded_vm_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Shielded VM Policies Org-Wide (Secure Boot and vTPM) (Tier-6 • Profile I)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.boolean_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure boolean_policy.enforced for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Restrict Public IP Creation on Compute Engine Virtual Machines (Tier-6 • Profile J)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Resource Manager within Serverless Event-Driven Pipeline & Workload Identity Federation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.

    group compute(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Serverless Secure Sandbox]

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_restrict_vm_external_ip_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict Public IP Creation on Compute Engine Virtual Machines (Tier-6 • Profile J)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.list_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure list_policy.denied_values for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

default allow = false

  r := input.resource_changes[_]

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_uniform_bucket_level_access_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Uniform Bucket-Level Access Across the Entire Organization Hierarchy (Tier-7 • Profile L)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.boolean_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure boolean_policy.enforced for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Disable Default Service Account Automatic Role Grants on Project Creation (Tier-7 • Profile M)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Resource Manager within Cloud Security Command Center (SCC) & Automated Incident Remediation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group detect(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Threat & Misconfig Discovery]
    group event(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Security Notification Bus]
    group remediate(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Automated Eventarc Remediation]

    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Premium Finding Engine] in detect
    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Audit Log Realtime Stream] in detect
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Detection Engine] in detect

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Security Notification Topic] in event
    service cr(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Cloud Run Remediation Handler] in event
    service svc(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Resource Manager] in event

    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Enforcer] in remediate
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Key Rotation] in remediate
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Monitoring Alert Channel] in remediate

    scc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:ps
    ps:R --> L:cr
    cr:B --> T:org
    org:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    cr:R --> L:mon

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_disable_default_sa_grants_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Disable Default Service Account Automatic Role Grants on Project Creation (Tier-7 • Profile M)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.boolean_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure boolean_policy.enforced for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Restrict Permitted Google Cloud Resource Locations to Approved Geographic Regions (Tier-7 • Profile N)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Resource Manager within Decoupled Enterprise Event Mesh & Cloud Pub/Sub Hardening. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_resource_locations_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict Permitted Google Cloud Resource Locations to Approved Geographic Regions (Tier-7 • Profile N)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.list_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure list_policy.allowed_values for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_require_shielded_vm_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Shielded VM Policies Org-Wide (Secure Boot and vTPM) (Tier-7 • Profile O)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.boolean_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure boolean_policy.enforced for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Restrict Public IP Creation on Compute Engine Virtual Machines (Tier-7 • Profile P)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Resource Manager within Hardened GKE Autopilot & Binary Authorization Ingress Pipeline. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor & Gateway API]
    group cluster(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Enterprise Autopilot Cluster]
    group supply(logos:gcp-artifact)[Supply Chain & Key Store]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Private DNS] in ingress
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor ML WAF] in ingress
    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[Private Service Connect] in ingress

    service gke(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Shielded Nodes] in cluster
    service svc(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Resource Manager] in cluster
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in cluster

    service art(logos:gcp-artifact)[Artifact Registry & Sigstore] in supply
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager] in supply
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Container Threat Detection] in supply

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:psc
    psc:B --> T:gke
    gke:R --> L:svc
    iam:B --> T:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    gke:R --> L:art
    art:R --> L:scc
opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_restrict_vm_external_ip_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Restrict Public IP Creation on Compute Engine Virtual Machines (Tier-7 • Profile P)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.list_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure list_policy.denied_values for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Domain Restricted Sharing Constraint (constraints/iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains) (Tier-8 • Profile Q)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Resource Manager within Mission-Critical Multi-Region Failover & Immutable Cloud Storage. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group routing(logos:gcp-armor)[Global Anycast External ALB]
    group region(logos:gcp-vpc)[Dual-Region Workload Enclave]
    group dr(logos:gcp-gcs)[Immutable Disaster Recovery Vault]

    service alb(logos:gcp-armor)[Global Cloud Load Balancing] in routing
    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Health Checks] in routing

    service prm(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Primary Service Instance] in region
    service stb(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Secondary Failover Replica] in region
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Dual-Region Key] in region

    service gcs(logos:gcp-gcs)[Immutable Bucket Lock] in dr
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Alert] in dr
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Incident SOAR] in dr

    alb:B --> T:prm
    dns:R --> L:alb
    prm:R --> L:stb
    prm:B --> T:kms
    stb:B --> T:kms
    prm:B --> T:gcs
    prm:R --> L:mon
    mon:R --> L:chr

package gcp.gcp_org_policy.gcp_org_policy_org_restrict_member_domains_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Domain Restricted Sharing Constraint (constraints/iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains) (Tier-8 • Profile Q)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_organization_policy"
  not r.change.after.list_policy
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure list_policy.allowed_values for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}

title: Enforce Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP) on External HTTPS Application Load Balancers
compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Identity-Aware Proxy within Zero Trust BeyondCorp Ingress & VPC-SC Perimeter Defense. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group edge(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress Tier]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[VPC-SC Trust Boundary Enclave]
    group sec(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Posture & SIEM Tier]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Zone] in edge
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor WAF] in edge
    service iap(logos:gcp-iap)[Identity-Aware Proxy] in edge

    service vpcnet(logos:gcp-vpc)[Hierarchical Firewall] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-iap)[Identity-Aware Proxy] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Aggregated Audit Sink] in sec
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Command Center] in sec
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM] in sec

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:iap
    iap:B --> T:vpcnet
    vpcnet:R --> L:svc
    svc:R --> L:kms
    svc:B --> T:log
    log:R --> L:scc
    scc:R --> L:chr

package gcp.gcp_iap.gcp_iap_iap_enabled_backend_service_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP) on External HTTPS Application Load Balancers
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_compute_backend_service"
  not r.change.after.iap
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure iap.enabled for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Context-Aware Access Levels on IAP Protected Web Resources
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Identity-Aware Proxy within Hardened GKE Autopilot & Binary Authorization Ingress Pipeline.     group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor & Gateway API]
    group cluster(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Enterprise Autopilot Cluster]
    group supply(logos:gcp-artifact)[Supply Chain & Key Store]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Private DNS] in ingress
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor ML WAF] in ingress
    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[Private Service Connect] in ingress

    service gke(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Shielded Nodes] in cluster
    service svc(logos:gcp-iap)[Identity-Aware Proxy] in cluster
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in cluster

    service art(logos:gcp-artifact)[Artifact Registry & Sigstore] in supply
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager] in supply
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Container Threat Detection] in supply

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:psc
    psc:B --> T:gke
    gke:R --> L:svc
    iam:B --> T:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    gke:R --> L:art
    art:R --> L:scc

package gcp.gcp_iap.gcp_iap_iap_tcp_forwarding_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce IAP TCP Forwarding for Zero Direct Internet SSH and RDP Ingress
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_iap_tunnel_instance_iam_binding"
  not r.change.after.role
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure role for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.

    group compute(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Serverless Secure Sandbox]

    iam:R --> L:cr
    cr:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    svc:R --> L:ps

    cr:B --> T:mon

package gcp.gcp_iap.gcp_iap_iap_jwt_verification_enforced_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Verify IAP Signed JWT Assertion Headers in Application Code
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_compute_backend_service"
  not r.change.after.iap
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure iap.oauth2_client_secret for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

package gcp.gcp_iap.gcp_iap_iap_enabled_backend_service_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP) on External HTTPS Application Load Balancers (Tier-2 • Profile E)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_compute_backend_service"
  not r.change.after.iap
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure iap.enabled for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Context-Aware Access Levels on IAP Protected Web Resources (Tier-2 • Profile F)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Identity-Aware Proxy within Data Perimeter & Private Service Connect (PSC) Architecture. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group auth(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access & Org Policy]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[Private Service Connect Enclave]
    group audit(logos:gcp-logging)[Centralized Audit & SIEM Sink]

    service caa(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access] in auth
    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Constraint] in auth

    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[PSC Endpoint Endpoint] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-iap)[Identity-Aware Proxy] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Cloud Logging Log Bucket] in audit
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Enterprise SIEM] in audit
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Continuous Compliance] in audit

    caa:R --> L:org
    org:B --> T:psc
    psc:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    svc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:scc

package gcp.gcp_iap.gcp_iap_iap_context_aware_access_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Context-Aware Access Levels on IAP Protected Web Resources (Tier-2 • Profile F)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_iap_web_backend_service_iam_binding"
  not r.change.after.condition
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure condition.expression for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce IAP TCP Forwarding for Zero Direct Internet SSH and RDP Ingress (Tier-2 • Profile G)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Identity-Aware Proxy within Cloud Security Command Center (SCC) & Automated Incident Remediation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group detect(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Threat & Misconfig Discovery]
    group event(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Security Notification Bus]
    group remediate(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Automated Eventarc Remediation]

    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Premium Finding Engine] in detect
    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Audit Log Realtime Stream] in detect
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Detection Engine] in detect

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Security Notification Topic] in event
    service cr(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Cloud Run Remediation Handler] in event
    service svc(logos:gcp-iap)[Identity-Aware Proxy] in event

    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Enforcer] in remediate
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Key Rotation] in remediate
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Monitoring Alert Channel] in remediate

    scc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:ps
    ps:R --> L:cr
    cr:B --> T:org
    org:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    cr:R --> L:mon

package gcp.gcp_iap.gcp_iap_iap_tcp_forwarding_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce IAP TCP Forwarding for Zero Direct Internet SSH and RDP Ingress (Tier-2 • Profile G)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_iap_tunnel_instance_iam_binding"
  not r.change.after.role
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure role for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Verify IAP Signed JWT Assertion Headers in Application Code (Tier-2 • Profile H)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Identity-Aware Proxy within Decoupled Enterprise Event Mesh & Cloud Pub/Sub Hardening. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.

package gcp.gcp_iap.gcp_iap_iap_jwt_verification_enforced_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Verify IAP Signed JWT Assertion Headers in Application Code (Tier-2 • Profile H)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_compute_backend_service"
  not r.change.after.iap
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure iap.oauth2_client_secret for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP) on External HTTPS Application Load Balancers (Tier-3 • Profile I)
compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Identity-Aware Proxy within Zero Trust BeyondCorp Ingress & VPC-SC Perimeter Defense. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group edge(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress Tier]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[VPC-SC Trust Boundary Enclave]
    group sec(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Posture & SIEM Tier]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Zone] in edge
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor WAF] in edge
    service iap(logos:gcp-iap)[Identity-Aware Proxy] in edge

    service vpcnet(logos:gcp-vpc)[Hierarchical Firewall] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-iap)[Identity-Aware Proxy] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Aggregated Audit Sink] in sec
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Command Center] in sec
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM] in sec

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:iap
    iap:B --> T:vpcnet
    vpcnet:R --> L:svc
    svc:R --> L:kms
    svc:B --> T:log
    log:R --> L:scc
    scc:R --> L:chr

opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_iap.gcp_iap_iap_enabled_backend_service_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP) on External HTTPS Application Load Balancers (Tier-3 • Profile I)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_compute_backend_service"
  not r.change.after.iap
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure iap.enabled for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Context-Aware Access Levels on IAP Protected Web Resources (Tier-3 • Profile J)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Identity-Aware Proxy within Hardened GKE Autopilot & Binary Authorization Ingress Pipeline. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor & Gateway API]
    group cluster(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Enterprise Autopilot Cluster]
    group supply(logos:gcp-artifact)[Supply Chain & Key Store]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Private DNS] in ingress
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor ML WAF] in ingress
    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[Private Service Connect] in ingress

    service gke(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Shielded Nodes] in cluster
    service svc(logos:gcp-iap)[Identity-Aware Proxy] in cluster
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in cluster

    service art(logos:gcp-artifact)[Artifact Registry & Sigstore] in supply
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager] in supply
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Container Threat Detection] in supply

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:psc
    psc:B --> T:gke
    gke:R --> L:svc
    iam:B --> T:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    gke:R --> L:art
    art:R --> L:scc

package gcp.gcp_iap.gcp_iap_iap_context_aware_access_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Context-Aware Access Levels on IAP Protected Web Resources (Tier-3 • Profile J)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_iap_web_backend_service_iam_binding"
  not r.change.after.condition
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure condition.expression for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce IAP TCP Forwarding for Zero Direct Internet SSH and RDP Ingress (Tier-3 • Profile K)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Identity-Aware Proxy within Mission-Critical Multi-Region Failover & Immutable Cloud Storage. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group routing(logos:gcp-armor)[Global Anycast External ALB]
    group region(logos:gcp-vpc)[Dual-Region Workload Enclave]
    group dr(logos:gcp-gcs)[Immutable Disaster Recovery Vault]

    service alb(logos:gcp-armor)[Global Cloud Load Balancing] in routing
    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Health Checks] in routing

    service prm(logos:gcp-iap)[Primary Service Instance] in region
    service stb(logos:gcp-iap)[Secondary Failover Replica] in region
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Dual-Region Key] in region

    service gcs(logos:gcp-gcs)[Immutable Bucket Lock] in dr
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Alert] in dr
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Incident SOAR] in dr

    alb:B --> T:prm
    dns:R --> L:alb
    prm:R --> L:stb
    prm:B --> T:kms
    stb:B --> T:kms
    prm:B --> T:gcs

package gcp.gcp_iap.gcp_iap_iap_tcp_forwarding_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce IAP TCP Forwarding for Zero Direct Internet SSH and RDP Ingress (Tier-3 • Profile K)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_iap_tunnel_instance_iam_binding"
  not r.change.after.role
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure role for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Verify IAP Signed JWT Assertion Headers in Application Code (Tier-3 • Profile L)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Identity-Aware Proxy within Serverless Event-Driven Pipeline & Workload Identity Federation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.

    group gateway(logos:gcp-armor)[API Gateway & Cloud Armor]
    group compute(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Serverless Secure Sandbox]
    group event(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub & Dead-Letter Hub]

    service gw(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor Edge Guard] in gateway
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity Pool] in gateway

    service cr(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Cloud Run Secure Container] in compute

    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager Vault] in compute

    service dlp(logos:gcp-dlp)[Cloud DLP Redaction] in event

    gw:B --> T:cr
    iam:R --> L:cr
    cr:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    svc:R --> L:ps
    ps:R --> L:dlp
    cr:B --> T:mon

package gcp.gcp_iap.gcp_iap_iap_jwt_verification_enforced_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Verify IAP Signed JWT Assertion Headers in Application Code (Tier-3 • Profile L)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_compute_backend_service"
  not r.change.after.iap
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure iap.oauth2_client_secret for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP) on External HTTPS Application Load Balancers (Tier-4 • Profile M)
compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Identity-Aware Proxy within Enterprise Vertex AI Sandbox & Confidential Space Enclave. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0.

package gcp.gcp_iap.gcp_iap_iap_enabled_backend_service_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP) on External HTTPS Application Load Balancers (Tier-4 • Profile M)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_compute_backend_service"
  not r.change.after.iap
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure iap.enabled for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Context-Aware Access Levels on IAP Protected Web Resources (Tier-4 • Profile N)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Identity-Aware Proxy within Data Perimeter & Private Service Connect (PSC) Architecture. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group auth(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access & Org Policy]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[Private Service Connect Enclave]
    group audit(logos:gcp-logging)[Centralized Audit & SIEM Sink]

    service caa(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access] in auth
    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Constraint] in auth

package gcp.gcp_iap.gcp_iap_iap_context_aware_access_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Context-Aware Access Levels on IAP Protected Web Resources (Tier-4 • Profile N)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_iap_web_backend_service_iam_binding"
  not r.change.after.condition
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure condition.expression for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce IAP TCP Forwarding for Zero Direct Internet SSH and RDP Ingress (Tier-4 • Profile O)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Identity-Aware Proxy within Cloud Security Command Center (SCC) & Automated Incident Remediation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group detect(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Threat & Misconfig Discovery]
    group event(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Security Notification Bus]
    group remediate(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Automated Eventarc Remediation]

    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Premium Finding Engine] in detect
    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Audit Log Realtime Stream] in detect
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Detection Engine] in detect

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Security Notification Topic] in event
    service cr(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Cloud Run Remediation Handler] in event
    service svc(logos:gcp-iap)[Identity-Aware Proxy] in event

    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Enforcer] in remediate
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Key Rotation] in remediate
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Monitoring Alert Channel] in remediate

    scc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:ps
    ps:R --> L:cr
    cr:B --> T:org
    org:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    cr:R --> L:mon

package gcp.gcp_iap.gcp_iap_iap_tcp_forwarding_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce IAP TCP Forwarding for Zero Direct Internet SSH and RDP Ingress (Tier-4 • Profile O)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_iap_tunnel_instance_iam_binding"
  not r.change.after.role
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure role for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Verify IAP Signed JWT Assertion Headers in Application Code (Tier-4 • Profile P)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Identity-Aware Proxy within Decoupled Enterprise Event Mesh & Cloud Pub/Sub Hardening. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress]
    group messaging(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Enterprise Mesh]
    group telemetry(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Observability & Audit]

    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor Protection] in ingress
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in ingress

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub KMS-Encrypted Topic] in messaging
    service svc(logos:gcp-iap)[Identity-Aware Proxy] in messaging
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager Envelope] in messaging

    service dlp(logos:gcp-dlp)[Cloud DLP Automatic Inspection] in telemetry
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Metrics] in telemetry
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM Ingestion] in telemetry

    arm:B --> T:ps
    iam:R --> L:ps
    ps:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    svc:R --> L:dlp
    dlp:R --> L:mon
    mon:B --> T:chr

package gcp.gcp_iap.gcp_iap_iap_jwt_verification_enforced_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Verify IAP Signed JWT Assertion Headers in Application Code (Tier-4 • Profile P)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_compute_backend_service"
  not r.change.after.iap
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure iap.oauth2_client_secret for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Identity-Aware Proxy (IAP) on External HTTPS Application Load Balancers (Tier-5 • Profile Q)
compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Identity-Aware Proxy within Zero Trust BeyondCorp Ingress & VPC-SC Perimeter Defense. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0.

architecture-beta
    group edge(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress Tier]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[VPC-SC Trust Boundary Enclave]
    group sec(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Posture & SIEM Tier]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Zone] in edge
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor WAF] in edge
    service iap(logos:gcp-iap)[Identity-Aware Proxy] in edge

    service vpcnet(logos:gcp-vpc)[Hierarchical Firewall] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-iap)[Identity-Aware Proxy] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Aggregated Audit Sink] in sec
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Command Center] in sec
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM] in sec

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:iap
    iap:B --> T:vpcnet
    vpcnet:R --> L:svc
    svc:R --> L:kms
    svc:B --> T:log
    log:R --> L:scc
    scc:R --> L:chr
