# Rule: Enforce Private Service Connect (PSC) for Google APIs and Zero Public Endpoints (Tier-14 • Profile N)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_compute_global_forwarding_rule"
  not r.change.after.target
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure target for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC) Service Perimeter Around Sensitive Data (Tier-14 • Profile O)
category_name: Private Service Connect & VPC Service Controls
compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Private Service Connect within Zero Trust BeyondCorp Ingress & VPC-SC Perimeter Defense. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group edge(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress Tier]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[VPC-SC Trust Boundary Enclave]
    group sec(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Posture & SIEM Tier]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Zone] in edge
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor WAF] in edge
    service iap(logos:gcp-iap)[Identity-Aware Proxy] in edge

    service vpcnet(logos:gcp-vpc)[Hierarchical Firewall] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-psc)[Private Service Connect] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Aggregated Audit Sink] in sec
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Command Center] in sec
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM] in sec

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:iap
    iap:B --> T:vpcnet
    vpcnet:R --> L:svc
    svc:R --> L:kms
    svc:B --> T:log
    log:R --> L:scc
    scc:R --> L:chr

opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_psc.gcp_psc_vpcsc_service_perimeter_enforced_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC) Service Perimeter Around Sensitive Data (Tier-14 • Profile O)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_access_context_manager_service_perimeter"
  not r.change.after.status
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure status.restricted_services for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Configure Ingress and Egress Rules for VPC-SC Cross-Perimeter Secure Exchanges (Tier-14 • Profile P)
category_name: Private Service Connect & VPC Service Controls
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Private Service Connect within Hardened GKE Autopilot & Binary Authorization Ingress Pipeline. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor & Gateway API]
    group cluster(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Enterprise Autopilot Cluster]
    group supply(logos:gcp-artifact)[Supply Chain & Key Store]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Private DNS] in ingress
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor ML WAF] in ingress
    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[Private Service Connect] in ingress

    service gke(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Shielded Nodes] in cluster
    service svc(logos:gcp-psc)[Private Service Connect] in cluster
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in cluster

    service art(logos:gcp-artifact)[Artifact Registry & Sigstore] in supply
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager] in supply
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Container Threat Detection] in supply

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:psc
    psc:B --> T:gke
    gke:R --> L:svc
    iam:B --> T:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    gke:R --> L:art
    art:R --> L:scc
opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_psc.gcp_psc_vpcsc_egress_policies_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Configure Ingress and Egress Rules for VPC-SC Cross-Perimeter Secure Exchanges (Tier-14 • Profile P)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_access_context_manager_service_perimeter"
  not r.change.after.status
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure status.egress_policies for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Private Service Connect (PSC) for Google APIs and Zero Public Endpoints (Tier-15 • Profile Q)
category_name: Private Service Connect & VPC Service Controls
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Private Service Connect within Mission-Critical Multi-Region Failover & Immutable Cloud Storage. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group routing(logos:gcp-armor)[Global Anycast External ALB]
    group region(logos:gcp-vpc)[Dual-Region Workload Enclave]
    group dr(logos:gcp-gcs)[Immutable Disaster Recovery Vault]

    service alb(logos:gcp-armor)[Global Cloud Load Balancing] in routing
    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Health Checks] in routing

    service prm(logos:gcp-psc)[Primary Service Instance] in region
    service stb(logos:gcp-psc)[Secondary Failover Replica] in region
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Dual-Region Key] in region

    service gcs(logos:gcp-gcs)[Immutable Bucket Lock] in dr
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Alert] in dr
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Incident SOAR] in dr

    alb:B --> T:prm
    dns:R --> L:alb
    prm:R --> L:stb
    prm:B --> T:kms
    stb:B --> T:kms
    prm:B --> T:gcs
    prm:R --> L:mon
    mon:R --> L:chr

package gcp.gcp_psc.gcp_psc_psc_google_apis_enforced_t15

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Private Service Connect (PSC) for Google APIs and Zero Public Endpoints (Tier-15 • Profile Q)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_compute_global_forwarding_rule"
  not r.change.after.target
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure target for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones
compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Zero Trust BeyondCorp Ingress & VPC-SC Perimeter Defense. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group edge(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress Tier]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[VPC-SC Trust Boundary Enclave]
    group sec(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Posture & SIEM Tier]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Zone] in edge
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor WAF] in edge
    service iap(logos:gcp-iap)[Identity-Aware Proxy] in edge

    service vpcnet(logos:gcp-vpc)[Hierarchical Firewall] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Aggregated Audit Sink] in sec
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Command Center] in sec
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM] in sec

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:iap
    iap:B --> T:vpcnet
    vpcnet:R --> L:svc
    svc:R --> L:kms
    svc:B --> T:log
    log:R --> L:scc
    scc:R --> L:chr

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_dnssec_enforced_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.dnssec_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure dnssec_config.state for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Hardened GKE Autopilot & Binary Authorization Ingress Pipeline. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor & Gateway API]
    group cluster(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Enterprise Autopilot Cluster]
    group supply(logos:gcp-artifact)[Supply Chain & Key Store]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Private DNS] in ingress
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor ML WAF] in ingress
    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[Private Service Connect] in ingress

    service gke(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Shielded Nodes] in cluster
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in cluster
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in cluster

    service art(logos:gcp-artifact)[Artifact Registry & Sigstore] in supply
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager] in supply
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Container Threat Detection] in supply

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:psc
    psc:B --> T:gke
    gke:R --> L:svc
    iam:B --> T:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    gke:R --> L:art
    art:R --> L:scc

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_private_zone_peering_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs

deny[msg] {

  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"

}

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_query_logging_stream_t1

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_policy"
  not r.change.after.enable_logging
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure enable_logging for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-2 • Profile D)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Serverless Event-Driven Pipeline & Workload Identity Federation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.

architecture-beta
    group gateway(logos:gcp-armor)[API Gateway & Cloud Armor]
    group compute(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Serverless Secure Sandbox]
    group event(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub & Dead-Letter Hub]

    service gw(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor Edge Guard] in gateway
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity Pool] in gateway

    service cr(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Cloud Run Secure Container] in compute
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in compute
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager Vault] in compute

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Encrypted Topic] in event
    service dlp(logos:gcp-dlp)[Cloud DLP Redaction] in event
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Dashboard] in event

    gw:B --> T:cr
    iam:R --> L:cr
    cr:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    svc:R --> L:ps
    ps:R --> L:dlp
    cr:B --> T:mon

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_dnssec_enforced_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-2 • Profile D)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.dnssec_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure dnssec_config.state for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Enterprise Vertex AI Sandbox & Confidential Space Enclave. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0.

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_private_zone_peering_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-2 • Profile E)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.visibility
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure visibility for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-2 • Profile F)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Data Perimeter & Private Service Connect (PSC) Architecture. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.

architecture-beta
    group auth(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access & Org Policy]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[Private Service Connect Enclave]
    group audit(logos:gcp-logging)[Centralized Audit & SIEM Sink]

    service caa(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access] in auth
    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Constraint] in auth

    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[PSC Endpoint Endpoint] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Cloud Logging Log Bucket] in audit
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Enterprise SIEM] in audit
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Continuous Compliance] in audit

    caa:R --> L:org
    org:B --> T:psc
    psc:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    svc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:scc

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_query_logging_stream_t2

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-2 • Profile F)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_policy"
  not r.change.after.enable_logging
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure enable_logging for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-3 • Profile G)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Cloud Security Command Center (SCC) & Automated Incident Remediation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group detect(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Threat & Misconfig Discovery]
    group event(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Security Notification Bus]
    group remediate(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Automated Eventarc Remediation]

    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Premium Finding Engine] in detect
    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Audit Log Realtime Stream] in detect
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Detection Engine] in detect

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Security Notification Topic] in event
    service cr(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Cloud Run Remediation Handler] in event
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in event

    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Enforcer] in remediate
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Key Rotation] in remediate
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Monitoring Alert Channel] in remediate

    scc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:ps
    ps:R --> L:cr
    cr:B --> T:org
    org:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    cr:R --> L:mon

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_dnssec_enforced_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-3 • Profile G)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.dnssec_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure dnssec_config.state for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-3 • Profile H)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Decoupled Enterprise Event Mesh & Cloud Pub/Sub Hardening. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress]
    group messaging(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Enterprise Mesh]
    group telemetry(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Observability & Audit]

    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor Protection] in ingress
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in ingress

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub KMS-Encrypted Topic] in messaging
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in messaging

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_private_zone_peering_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-3 • Profile H)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.visibility
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure visibility for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-3 • Profile I)
compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Zero Trust BeyondCorp Ingress & VPC-SC Perimeter Defense. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group edge(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress Tier]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[VPC-SC Trust Boundary Enclave]
    group sec(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Posture & SIEM Tier]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Zone] in edge
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor WAF] in edge
    service iap(logos:gcp-iap)[Identity-Aware Proxy] in edge

    service vpcnet(logos:gcp-vpc)[Hierarchical Firewall] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Aggregated Audit Sink] in sec
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Command Center] in sec
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM] in sec

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:iap
    iap:B --> T:vpcnet
    vpcnet:R --> L:svc
    svc:R --> L:kms
    svc:B --> T:log
    log:R --> L:scc
    scc:R --> L:chr

opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_query_logging_stream_t3

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-3 • Profile I)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_policy"
  not r.change.after.enable_logging
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure enable_logging for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-4 • Profile J)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Hardened GKE Autopilot & Binary Authorization Ingress Pipeline. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor & Gateway API]
    group cluster(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Enterprise Autopilot Cluster]
    group supply(logos:gcp-artifact)[Supply Chain & Key Store]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Private DNS] in ingress
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor ML WAF] in ingress
    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[Private Service Connect] in ingress

    service gke(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Shielded Nodes] in cluster
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in cluster
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in cluster

    service art(logos:gcp-artifact)[Artifact Registry & Sigstore] in supply
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager] in supply
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Container Threat Detection] in supply

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:psc
    psc:B --> T:gke
    gke:R --> L:svc
    iam:B --> T:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    gke:R --> L:art
    art:R --> L:scc
opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_dnssec_enforced_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-4 • Profile J)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.dnssec_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure dnssec_config.state for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-4 • Profile K)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Mission-Critical Multi-Region Failover & Immutable Cloud Storage. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.

architecture-beta
    group routing(logos:gcp-armor)[Global Anycast External ALB]
    group region(logos:gcp-vpc)[Dual-Region Workload Enclave]
    group dr(logos:gcp-gcs)[Immutable Disaster Recovery Vault]

    service alb(logos:gcp-armor)[Global Cloud Load Balancing] in routing
    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Health Checks] in routing

    service prm(logos:gcp-dns)[Primary Service Instance] in region
    service stb(logos:gcp-dns)[Secondary Failover Replica] in region
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Dual-Region Key] in region

    service gcs(logos:gcp-gcs)[Immutable Bucket Lock] in dr
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Alert] in dr
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Incident SOAR] in dr

    alb:B --> T:prm
    dns:R --> L:alb
    prm:R --> L:stb
    prm:B --> T:kms
    stb:B --> T:kms
    prm:B --> T:gcs
    prm:R --> L:mon
    mon:R --> L:chr

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_private_zone_peering_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-4 • Profile K)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.visibility
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure visibility for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_query_logging_stream_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-4 • Profile L)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_policy"
  not r.change.after.enable_logging
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure enable_logging for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_dnssec_enforced_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-5 • Profile M)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.dnssec_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure dnssec_config.state for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-5 • Profile N)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Data Perimeter & Private Service Connect (PSC) Architecture. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.

architecture-beta
    group auth(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access & Org Policy]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[Private Service Connect Enclave]
    group audit(logos:gcp-logging)[Centralized Audit & SIEM Sink]

    service caa(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access] in auth
    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Constraint] in auth

    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[PSC Endpoint Endpoint] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Cloud Logging Log Bucket] in audit
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Enterprise SIEM] in audit
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Continuous Compliance] in audit

    caa:R --> L:org
    org:B --> T:psc
    psc:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    svc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:scc

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_private_zone_peering_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-5 • Profile N)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.visibility
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure visibility for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-5 • Profile O)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Cloud Security Command Center (SCC) & Automated Incident Remediation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group detect(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Threat & Misconfig Discovery]
    group event(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Security Notification Bus]
    group remediate(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Automated Eventarc Remediation]

    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Premium Finding Engine] in detect
    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Audit Log Realtime Stream] in detect
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Detection Engine] in detect

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Security Notification Topic] in event
    service cr(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Cloud Run Remediation Handler] in event
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in event

    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Enforcer] in remediate
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Key Rotation] in remediate
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Monitoring Alert Channel] in remediate

    scc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:ps
    ps:R --> L:cr
    cr:B --> T:org
    org:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    cr:R --> L:mon

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_query_logging_stream_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-5 • Profile O)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_policy"
  not r.change.after.enable_logging
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure enable_logging for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-6 • Profile P)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Decoupled Enterprise Event Mesh & Cloud Pub/Sub Hardening. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress]
    group messaging(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Enterprise Mesh]
    group telemetry(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Observability & Audit]

    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor Protection] in ingress
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in ingress

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub KMS-Encrypted Topic] in messaging
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in messaging
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager Envelope] in messaging

    service dlp(logos:gcp-dlp)[Cloud DLP Automatic Inspection] in telemetry
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Metrics] in telemetry
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM Ingestion] in telemetry

    arm:B --> T:ps
    iam:R --> L:ps
    ps:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    svc:R --> L:dlp
    dlp:R --> L:mon
    mon:B --> T:chr

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_dnssec_enforced_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-6 • Profile P)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.dnssec_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure dnssec_config.state for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-6 • Profile Q)
compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Zero Trust BeyondCorp Ingress & VPC-SC Perimeter Defense. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0.

architecture-beta
    group edge(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress Tier]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Zone] in edge

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Aggregated Audit Sink] in sec

    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM] in sec

    dns:R --> L:arm

    iap:B --> T:vpcnet
    vpcnet:R --> L:svc
    svc:R --> L:kms
    svc:B --> T:log
    log:R --> L:scc
    scc:R --> L:chr

opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_private_zone_peering_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-6 • Profile Q)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.visibility
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure visibility for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-6 • Profile R)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Hardened GKE Autopilot & Binary Authorization Ingress Pipeline. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor & Gateway API]
    group cluster(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Enterprise Autopilot Cluster]
    group supply(logos:gcp-artifact)[Supply Chain & Key Store]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Private DNS] in ingress
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor ML WAF] in ingress
    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[Private Service Connect] in ingress

    service gke(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Shielded Nodes] in cluster
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in cluster
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in cluster

    service art(logos:gcp-artifact)[Artifact Registry & Sigstore] in supply
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager] in supply
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Container Threat Detection] in supply

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:psc
    psc:B --> T:gke
    gke:R --> L:svc
    iam:B --> T:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    gke:R --> L:art
    art:R --> L:scc
opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_query_logging_stream_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-6 • Profile R)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_policy"
  not r.change.after.enable_logging
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure enable_logging for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-7 • Profile S)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Mission-Critical Multi-Region Failover & Immutable Cloud Storage. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group routing(logos:gcp-armor)[Global Anycast External ALB]
    group region(logos:gcp-vpc)[Dual-Region Workload Enclave]
    group dr(logos:gcp-gcs)[Immutable Disaster Recovery Vault]

    service alb(logos:gcp-armor)[Global Cloud Load Balancing] in routing
    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Health Checks] in routing

    service prm(logos:gcp-dns)[Primary Service Instance] in region
    service stb(logos:gcp-dns)[Secondary Failover Replica] in region
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Dual-Region Key] in region

    service gcs(logos:gcp-gcs)[Immutable Bucket Lock] in dr
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Alert] in dr
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Incident SOAR] in dr

    alb:B --> T:prm
    dns:R --> L:alb
    prm:R --> L:stb
    prm:B --> T:kms
    stb:B --> T:kms
    prm:B --> T:gcs
    prm:R --> L:mon
    mon:R --> L:chr

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_dnssec_enforced_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-7 • Profile S)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.dnssec_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure dnssec_config.state for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-7 • Profile T)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Serverless Event-Driven Pipeline & Workload Identity Federation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.

    group gateway(logos:gcp-armor)[API Gateway & Cloud Armor]
    group compute(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Serverless Secure Sandbox]
    group event(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub & Dead-Letter Hub]

    service gw(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor Edge Guard] in gateway
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity Pool] in gateway

    service cr(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Cloud Run Secure Container] in compute
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in compute
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager Vault] in compute

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Encrypted Topic] in event
    service dlp(logos:gcp-dlp)[Cloud DLP Redaction] in event
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Dashboard] in event

    gw:B --> T:cr
    iam:R --> L:cr
    cr:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    svc:R --> L:ps
    ps:R --> L:dlp
    cr:B --> T:mon

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_private_zone_peering_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-7 • Profile T)

deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.visibility
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure visibility for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_query_logging_stream_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-7 • Profile U)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_policy"
  not r.change.after.enable_logging
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure enable_logging for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-8 • Profile V)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Data Perimeter & Private Service Connect (PSC) Architecture. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.

architecture-beta
    group auth(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access & Org Policy]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[Private Service Connect Enclave]
    group audit(logos:gcp-logging)[Centralized Audit & SIEM Sink]

    service caa(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access] in auth
    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Constraint] in auth

    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[PSC Endpoint Endpoint] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Cloud Logging Log Bucket] in audit
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Enterprise SIEM] in audit
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Continuous Compliance] in audit

    caa:R --> L:org
    org:B --> T:psc
    psc:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    svc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:scc

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_dnssec_enforced_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-8 • Profile V)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.dnssec_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure dnssec_config.state for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-8 • Profile W)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Cloud Security Command Center (SCC) & Automated Incident Remediation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group detect(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Threat & Misconfig Discovery]
    group event(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Security Notification Bus]
    group remediate(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Automated Eventarc Remediation]

    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Premium Finding Engine] in detect
    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Audit Log Realtime Stream] in detect
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Detection Engine] in detect

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Security Notification Topic] in event
    service cr(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Cloud Run Remediation Handler] in event
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in event

    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Enforcer] in remediate
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Key Rotation] in remediate
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Monitoring Alert Channel] in remediate

    scc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:ps
    ps:R --> L:cr
    cr:B --> T:org
    org:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    cr:R --> L:mon

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_private_zone_peering_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-8 • Profile W)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.visibility
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure visibility for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-8 • Profile X)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Decoupled Enterprise Event Mesh & Cloud Pub/Sub Hardening. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress]
    group messaging(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Enterprise Mesh]
    group telemetry(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Observability & Audit]

    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor Protection] in ingress
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in ingress

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub KMS-Encrypted Topic] in messaging
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in messaging
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager Envelope] in messaging

    service dlp(logos:gcp-dlp)[Cloud DLP Automatic Inspection] in telemetry
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Metrics] in telemetry
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM Ingestion] in telemetry

    arm:B --> T:ps
    iam:R --> L:ps
    ps:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    svc:R --> L:dlp
    dlp:R --> L:mon
    mon:B --> T:chr

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_query_logging_stream_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-8 • Profile X)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_policy"
  not r.change.after.enable_logging
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure enable_logging for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Zero Trust BeyondCorp Ingress & VPC-SC Perimeter Defense. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0.

    group edge(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress Tier]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[VPC-SC Trust Boundary Enclave]
    group sec(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Posture & SIEM Tier]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Zone] in edge
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor WAF] in edge
    service iap(logos:gcp-iap)[Identity-Aware Proxy] in edge

    service vpcnet(logos:gcp-vpc)[Hierarchical Firewall] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Aggregated Audit Sink] in sec
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Command Center] in sec
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM] in sec

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:iap
    iap:B --> T:vpcnet
    vpcnet:R --> L:svc
    svc:R --> L:kms
    svc:B --> T:log
    log:R --> L:scc
    scc:R --> L:chr

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_dnssec_enforced_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-9 • Profile Y)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.dnssec_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure dnssec_config.state for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-9 • Profile Z)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Hardened GKE Autopilot & Binary Authorization Ingress Pipeline. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor & Gateway API]
    group cluster(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Enterprise Autopilot Cluster]
    group supply(logos:gcp-artifact)[Supply Chain & Key Store]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Private DNS] in ingress
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor ML WAF] in ingress
    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[Private Service Connect] in ingress

    service gke(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Shielded Nodes] in cluster
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in cluster
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in cluster

    service art(logos:gcp-artifact)[Artifact Registry & Sigstore] in supply
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager] in supply
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Container Threat Detection] in supply

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:psc
    psc:B --> T:gke
    gke:R --> L:svc
    iam:B --> T:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    gke:R --> L:art
    art:R --> L:scc

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_private_zone_peering_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-9 • Profile Z)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {

  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.visibility
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure visibility for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_query_logging_stream_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-9 • Profile A)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_policy"
  not r.change.after.enable_logging
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure enable_logging for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-10 • Profile B)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Serverless Event-Driven Pipeline & Workload Identity Federation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.

    group gateway(logos:gcp-armor)[API Gateway & Cloud Armor]
    group compute(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Serverless Secure Sandbox]
    group event(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub & Dead-Letter Hub]

    service gw(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor Edge Guard] in gateway
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity Pool] in gateway

    service cr(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Cloud Run Secure Container] in compute
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in compute
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager Vault] in compute

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Encrypted Topic] in event
    service dlp(logos:gcp-dlp)[Cloud DLP Redaction] in event
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Dashboard] in event

    gw:B --> T:cr
    iam:R --> L:cr
    cr:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    svc:R --> L:ps
    ps:R --> L:dlp
    cr:B --> T:mon

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_dnssec_enforced_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-10 • Profile B)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.dnssec_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure dnssec_config.state for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Enterprise Vertex AI Sandbox & Confidential Space Enclave. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0.

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_private_zone_peering_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-10 • Profile C)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.visibility
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure visibility for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-10 • Profile D)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Data Perimeter & Private Service Connect (PSC) Architecture. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.

architecture-beta
    group auth(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access & Org Policy]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[Private Service Connect Enclave]
    group audit(logos:gcp-logging)[Centralized Audit & SIEM Sink]

    service caa(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access] in auth
    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Constraint] in auth

    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[PSC Endpoint Endpoint] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Cloud Logging Log Bucket] in audit
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Enterprise SIEM] in audit
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Continuous Compliance] in audit

    caa:R --> L:org

    psc:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    svc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:scc

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_query_logging_stream_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-10 • Profile D)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_policy"
  not r.change.after.enable_logging
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure enable_logging for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-11 • Profile E)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Cloud Security Command Center (SCC) & Automated Incident Remediation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group detect(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Threat & Misconfig Discovery]
    group event(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Security Notification Bus]
    group remediate(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Automated Eventarc Remediation]

    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Premium Finding Engine] in detect
    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Audit Log Realtime Stream] in detect
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Detection Engine] in detect

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Security Notification Topic] in event
    service cr(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Cloud Run Remediation Handler] in event
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in event

    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Enforcer] in remediate
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Key Rotation] in remediate
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Monitoring Alert Channel] in remediate

    scc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:ps
    ps:R --> L:cr
    cr:B --> T:org
    org:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    cr:R --> L:mon

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_dnssec_enforced_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-11 • Profile E)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.dnssec_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure dnssec_config.state for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_private_zone_peering_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-11 • Profile F)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.visibility
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure visibility for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-11 • Profile G)
compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Zero Trust BeyondCorp Ingress & VPC-SC Perimeter Defense. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group edge(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress Tier]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[VPC-SC Trust Boundary Enclave]
    group sec(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Posture & SIEM Tier]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Zone] in edge
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor WAF] in edge
    service iap(logos:gcp-iap)[Identity-Aware Proxy] in edge

    service vpcnet(logos:gcp-vpc)[Hierarchical Firewall] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Aggregated Audit Sink] in sec
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Command Center] in sec
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM] in sec

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:iap
    iap:B --> T:vpcnet
    vpcnet:R --> L:svc
    svc:R --> L:kms
    svc:B --> T:log
    log:R --> L:scc
    scc:R --> L:chr

opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_query_logging_stream_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-11 • Profile G)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_policy"
  not r.change.after.enable_logging
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure enable_logging for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-12 • Profile H)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Hardened GKE Autopilot & Binary Authorization Ingress Pipeline. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor & Gateway API]
    group cluster(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Enterprise Autopilot Cluster]
    group supply(logos:gcp-artifact)[Supply Chain & Key Store]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Private DNS] in ingress
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor ML WAF] in ingress
    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[Private Service Connect] in ingress

    service gke(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Shielded Nodes] in cluster
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in cluster
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in cluster

    service art(logos:gcp-artifact)[Artifact Registry & Sigstore] in supply
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager] in supply
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Container Threat Detection] in supply

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:psc
    psc:B --> T:gke
    gke:R --> L:svc
    iam:B --> T:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    gke:R --> L:art
    art:R --> L:scc
opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_dnssec_enforced_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-12 • Profile H)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.dnssec_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure dnssec_config.state for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_private_zone_peering_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-12 • Profile I)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.visibility
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure visibility for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_query_logging_stream_t12

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-12 • Profile J)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_policy"
  not r.change.after.enable_logging
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure enable_logging for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_dnssec_enforced_t13

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-13 • Profile K)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.dnssec_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure dnssec_config.state for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-13 • Profile L)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Data Perimeter & Private Service Connect (PSC) Architecture. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.

architecture-beta
    group auth(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access & Org Policy]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[Private Service Connect Enclave]
    group audit(logos:gcp-logging)[Centralized Audit & SIEM Sink]

    service caa(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access] in auth
    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Constraint] in auth

    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[PSC Endpoint Endpoint] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Cloud Logging Log Bucket] in audit
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Enterprise SIEM] in audit
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Continuous Compliance] in audit

    caa:R --> L:org
    org:B --> T:psc
    psc:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    svc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:scc

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_private_zone_peering_t13

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-13 • Profile L)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.visibility
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure visibility for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-13 • Profile M)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Cloud Security Command Center (SCC) & Automated Incident Remediation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group detect(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Threat & Misconfig Discovery]
    group event(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Security Notification Bus]
    group remediate(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Automated Eventarc Remediation]

    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Premium Finding Engine] in detect
    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Audit Log Realtime Stream] in detect
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Detection Engine] in detect

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Security Notification Topic] in event
    service cr(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Cloud Run Remediation Handler] in event
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in event

    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Enforcer] in remediate
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Key Rotation] in remediate
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Monitoring Alert Channel] in remediate

    scc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:ps
    ps:R --> L:cr
    cr:B --> T:org
    org:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    cr:R --> L:mon

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_query_logging_stream_t13

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-13 • Profile M)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_policy"
  not r.change.after.enable_logging
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure enable_logging for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-14 • Profile N)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Decoupled Enterprise Event Mesh & Cloud Pub/Sub Hardening. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress]
    group messaging(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Enterprise Mesh]
    group telemetry(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Observability & Audit]

    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor Protection] in ingress
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in ingress

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub KMS-Encrypted Topic] in messaging
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in messaging
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager Envelope] in messaging

    service dlp(logos:gcp-dlp)[Cloud DLP Automatic Inspection] in telemetry
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Metrics] in telemetry
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM Ingestion] in telemetry

    arm:B --> T:ps
    iam:R --> L:ps
    ps:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    svc:R --> L:dlp
    dlp:R --> L:mon
    mon:B --> T:chr

package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_dnssec_enforced_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-14 • Profile N)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.dnssec_config
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure dnssec_config.state for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-14 • Profile O)
compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Zero Trust BeyondCorp Ingress & VPC-SC Perimeter Defense. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0.

architecture-beta
    group edge(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress Tier]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[VPC-SC Trust Boundary Enclave]
    group sec(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Posture & SIEM Tier]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Zone] in edge
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor WAF] in edge
    service iap(logos:gcp-iap)[Identity-Aware Proxy] in edge

    service vpcnet(logos:gcp-vpc)[Hierarchical Firewall] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Aggregated Audit Sink] in sec
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Command Center] in sec
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM] in sec

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:iap
    iap:B --> T:vpcnet
    vpcnet:R --> L:svc
    svc:R --> L:kms
    svc:B --> T:log
    log:R --> L:scc
    scc:R --> L:chr

opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_private_zone_peering_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Deploy Private Cloud DNS Zones Linked Exclusively to Authorized Project VPCs (Tier-14 • Profile O)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_managed_zone"
  not r.change.after.visibility
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure visibility for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-14 • Profile P)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Hardened GKE Autopilot & Binary Authorization Ingress Pipeline. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor & Gateway API]
    group cluster(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Enterprise Autopilot Cluster]
    group supply(logos:gcp-artifact)[Supply Chain & Key Store]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Private DNS] in ingress
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor ML WAF] in ingress
    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[Private Service Connect] in ingress

    service gke(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Shielded Nodes] in cluster
    service svc(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS] in cluster
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in cluster

    service art(logos:gcp-artifact)[Artifact Registry & Sigstore] in supply
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager] in supply
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Container Threat Detection] in supply

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:psc
    psc:B --> T:gke
    gke:R --> L:svc
    iam:B --> T:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    gke:R --> L:art
    art:R --> L:scc
opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_dns.gcp_dns_dns_query_logging_stream_t14

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable Cloud DNS Query Logging to Central Log Analytics Workspace (Tier-14 • Profile P)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_dns_policy"
  not r.change.after.enable_logging
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure enable_logging for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce DNSSEC Validation and Signing on Public Managed Cloud DNS Zones (Tier-15 • Profile Q)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for Cloud DNS within Mission-Critical Multi-Region Failover & Immutable Cloud Storage. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group routing(logos:gcp-armor)[Global Anycast External ALB]
    group region(logos:gcp-vpc)[Dual-Region Workload Enclave]
    group dr(logos:gcp-gcs)[Immutable Disaster Recovery Vault]

    service alb(logos:gcp-armor)[Global Cloud Load Balancing] in routing
    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Health Checks] in routing

    service prm(logos:gcp-dns)[Primary Service Instance] in region
    service stb(logos:gcp-dns)[Secondary Failover Replica] in region
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Dual-Region Key] in region

    service gcs(logos:gcp-gcs)[Immutable Bucket Lock] in dr
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Alert] in dr
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Incident SOAR] in dr

    alb:B --> T:prm
    dns:R --> L:alb
    prm:R --> L:stb
    prm:B --> T:kms
    stb:B --> T:kms
    prm:B --> T:gcs
    prm:R --> L:mon
    mon:R --> L:chr
