package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_partition_expiration_t4

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable BigQuery Continuous Audit Logging and Partition Expiration Guardrails (Tier-4 • Profile P)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_bigquery_table"
  not r.change.after.time_partitioning
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure time_partitioning.expiration_ms for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0.

opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_cmek_encryption_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) on BigQuery Datasets & Tables (Tier-5 • Profile Q)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_bigquery_dataset"
  not r.change.after.default_encryption_configuration
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure default_encryption_configuration.kms_key_name for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Column-Level Access Control via BigQuery Policy Tags and Data Catalog (Tier-5 • Profile R)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for BigQuery within Hardened GKE Autopilot & Binary Authorization Ingress Pipeline. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor & Gateway API]
    group cluster(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Enterprise Autopilot Cluster]
    group supply(logos:gcp-artifact)[Supply Chain & Key Store]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Private DNS] in ingress
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor ML WAF] in ingress
    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[Private Service Connect] in ingress

    service gke(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Shielded Nodes] in cluster
    service svc(logos:gcp-bigquery)[BigQuery] in cluster
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in cluster

    service art(logos:gcp-artifact)[Artifact Registry & Sigstore] in supply
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager] in supply
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Container Threat Detection] in supply

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:psc
    psc:B --> T:gke
    gke:R --> L:svc
    iam:B --> T:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    gke:R --> L:art
    art:R --> L:scc
opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_column_level_security_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Column-Level Access Control via BigQuery Policy Tags and Data Catalog (Tier-5 • Profile R)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_data_catalog_policy_tag"
  not r.change.after.display_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure display_name for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Disable Public Dataset Access and Enforce Authorized Views for Restricted Sharing (Tier-5 • Profile S)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for BigQuery within Mission-Critical Multi-Region Failover & Immutable Cloud Storage. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.

    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Incident SOAR] in dr

package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_no_public_access_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Disable Public Dataset Access and Enforce Authorized Views for Restricted Sharing (Tier-5 • Profile S)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_bigquery_dataset_access"
  not r.change.after.special_group
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure special_group for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enable BigQuery Continuous Audit Logging and Partition Expiration Guardrails (Tier-5 • Profile T)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for BigQuery within Serverless Event-Driven Pipeline & Workload Identity Federation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.

    group compute(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Serverless Secure Sandbox]

    iam:R --> L:cr
    cr:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    svc:R --> L:ps
    ps:R --> L:dlp

package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_partition_expiration_t5

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable BigQuery Continuous Audit Logging and Partition Expiration Guardrails (Tier-5 • Profile T)

deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_bigquery_table"
  not r.change.after.time_partitioning
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure time_partitioning.expiration_ms for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}

package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_cmek_encryption_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) on BigQuery Datasets & Tables (Tier-6 • Profile U)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_bigquery_dataset"
  not r.change.after.default_encryption_configuration
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure default_encryption_configuration.kms_key_name for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Column-Level Access Control via BigQuery Policy Tags and Data Catalog (Tier-6 • Profile V)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for BigQuery within Data Perimeter & Private Service Connect (PSC) Architecture. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group auth(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access & Org Policy]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[Private Service Connect Enclave]
    group audit(logos:gcp-logging)[Centralized Audit & SIEM Sink]

    service caa(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access] in auth
    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Constraint] in auth

    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[PSC Endpoint Endpoint] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-bigquery)[BigQuery] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Cloud Logging Log Bucket] in audit
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Enterprise SIEM] in audit
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Continuous Compliance] in audit

    caa:R --> L:org
    org:B --> T:psc
    psc:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    svc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:scc

package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_column_level_security_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Column-Level Access Control via BigQuery Policy Tags and Data Catalog (Tier-6 • Profile V)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_data_catalog_policy_tag"
  not r.change.after.display_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure display_name for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Disable Public Dataset Access and Enforce Authorized Views for Restricted Sharing (Tier-6 • Profile W)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for BigQuery within Cloud Security Command Center (SCC) & Automated Incident Remediation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group detect(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Threat & Misconfig Discovery]
    group event(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Security Notification Bus]
    group remediate(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Automated Eventarc Remediation]

    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Premium Finding Engine] in detect
    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Audit Log Realtime Stream] in detect
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Detection Engine] in detect

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Security Notification Topic] in event
    service cr(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Cloud Run Remediation Handler] in event
    service svc(logos:gcp-bigquery)[BigQuery] in event

    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Enforcer] in remediate
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Key Rotation] in remediate
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Monitoring Alert Channel] in remediate

    scc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:ps
    ps:R --> L:cr
    cr:B --> T:org
    org:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    cr:R --> L:mon

package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_no_public_access_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Disable Public Dataset Access and Enforce Authorized Views for Restricted Sharing (Tier-6 • Profile W)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_bigquery_dataset_access"
  not r.change.after.special_group
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure special_group for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enable BigQuery Continuous Audit Logging and Partition Expiration Guardrails (Tier-6 • Profile X)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for BigQuery within Decoupled Enterprise Event Mesh & Cloud Pub/Sub Hardening. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.

architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress]
    group messaging(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Enterprise Mesh]
    group telemetry(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Observability & Audit]

    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor Protection] in ingress
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in ingress

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub KMS-Encrypted Topic] in messaging
    service svc(logos:gcp-bigquery)[BigQuery] in messaging
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager Envelope] in messaging

    service dlp(logos:gcp-dlp)[Cloud DLP Automatic Inspection] in telemetry
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Metrics] in telemetry
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM Ingestion] in telemetry

    arm:B --> T:ps
    iam:R --> L:ps
    ps:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    svc:R --> L:dlp
    dlp:R --> L:mon
    mon:B --> T:chr

package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_partition_expiration_t6

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable BigQuery Continuous Audit Logging and Partition Expiration Guardrails (Tier-6 • Profile X)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_bigquery_table"
  not r.change.after.time_partitioning
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure time_partitioning.expiration_ms for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) on BigQuery Datasets & Tables (Tier-7 • Profile Y)
compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for BigQuery within Zero Trust BeyondCorp Ingress & VPC-SC Perimeter Defense. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0.

architecture-beta
    group edge(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress Tier]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[VPC-SC Trust Boundary Enclave]
    group sec(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Posture & SIEM Tier]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Zone] in edge
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor WAF] in edge
    service iap(logos:gcp-iap)[Identity-Aware Proxy] in edge

    service vpcnet(logos:gcp-vpc)[Hierarchical Firewall] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-bigquery)[BigQuery] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Aggregated Audit Sink] in sec
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Command Center] in sec
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM] in sec

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:iap
    iap:B --> T:vpcnet
    vpcnet:R --> L:svc
    svc:R --> L:kms
    svc:B --> T:log
    log:R --> L:scc
    scc:R --> L:chr

opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_cmek_encryption_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) on BigQuery Datasets & Tables (Tier-7 • Profile Y)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_bigquery_dataset"
  not r.change.after.default_encryption_configuration
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure default_encryption_configuration.kms_key_name for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Column-Level Access Control via BigQuery Policy Tags and Data Catalog (Tier-7 • Profile Z)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for BigQuery within Hardened GKE Autopilot & Binary Authorization Ingress Pipeline. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor & Gateway API]
    group cluster(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Enterprise Autopilot Cluster]
    group supply(logos:gcp-artifact)[Supply Chain & Key Store]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Private DNS] in ingress
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor ML WAF] in ingress
    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[Private Service Connect] in ingress

    service gke(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Shielded Nodes] in cluster
    service svc(logos:gcp-bigquery)[BigQuery] in cluster
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in cluster

    service art(logos:gcp-artifact)[Artifact Registry & Sigstore] in supply
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager] in supply
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Container Threat Detection] in supply

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:psc
    psc:B --> T:gke
    gke:R --> L:svc
    iam:B --> T:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    gke:R --> L:art
    art:R --> L:scc

package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_column_level_security_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Column-Level Access Control via BigQuery Policy Tags and Data Catalog (Tier-7 • Profile Z)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_data_catalog_policy_tag"
  not r.change.after.display_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure display_name for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}

    group region(logos:gcp-vpc)[Dual-Region Workload Enclave]

package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_no_public_access_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Disable Public Dataset Access and Enforce Authorized Views for Restricted Sharing (Tier-7 • Profile A)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_bigquery_dataset_access"
  not r.change.after.special_group
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure special_group for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enable BigQuery Continuous Audit Logging and Partition Expiration Guardrails (Tier-7 • Profile B)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for BigQuery within Serverless Event-Driven Pipeline & Workload Identity Federation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.

    group compute(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Serverless Secure Sandbox]

    svc:B --> T:sec
    svc:R --> L:ps

    cr:B --> T:mon

package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_partition_expiration_t7

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable BigQuery Continuous Audit Logging and Partition Expiration Guardrails (Tier-7 • Profile B)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_bigquery_table"
  not r.change.after.time_partitioning
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure time_partitioning.expiration_ms for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_cmek_encryption_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) on BigQuery Datasets & Tables (Tier-8 • Profile C)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_bigquery_dataset"
  not r.change.after.default_encryption_configuration
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure default_encryption_configuration.kms_key_name for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Column-Level Access Control via BigQuery Policy Tags and Data Catalog (Tier-8 • Profile D)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for BigQuery within Data Perimeter & Private Service Connect (PSC) Architecture. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group auth(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access & Org Policy]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[Private Service Connect Enclave]
    group audit(logos:gcp-logging)[Centralized Audit & SIEM Sink]

package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_column_level_security_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Column-Level Access Control via BigQuery Policy Tags and Data Catalog (Tier-8 • Profile D)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_data_catalog_policy_tag"
  not r.change.after.display_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure display_name for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Disable Public Dataset Access and Enforce Authorized Views for Restricted Sharing (Tier-8 • Profile E)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for BigQuery within Cloud Security Command Center (SCC) & Automated Incident Remediation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group detect(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Threat & Misconfig Discovery]
    group event(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Security Notification Bus]
    group remediate(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Automated Eventarc Remediation]

    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Premium Finding Engine] in detect
    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Audit Log Realtime Stream] in detect
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Detection Engine] in detect

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Security Notification Topic] in event
    service cr(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Cloud Run Remediation Handler] in event
    service svc(logos:gcp-bigquery)[BigQuery] in event

    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Enforcer] in remediate
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Key Rotation] in remediate
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Monitoring Alert Channel] in remediate

    scc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:ps
    ps:R --> L:cr
    cr:B --> T:org
    org:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    cr:R --> L:mon

package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_no_public_access_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Disable Public Dataset Access and Enforce Authorized Views for Restricted Sharing (Tier-8 • Profile E)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_bigquery_dataset_access"
  not r.change.after.special_group
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure special_group for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enable BigQuery Continuous Audit Logging and Partition Expiration Guardrails (Tier-8 • Profile F)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for BigQuery within Decoupled Enterprise Event Mesh & Cloud Pub/Sub Hardening. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress]
    group messaging(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Enterprise Mesh]
    group telemetry(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Observability & Audit]

    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor Protection] in ingress
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in ingress

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub KMS-Encrypted Topic] in messaging
    service svc(logos:gcp-bigquery)[BigQuery] in messaging
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager Envelope] in messaging

    service dlp(logos:gcp-dlp)[Cloud DLP Automatic Inspection] in telemetry
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Metrics] in telemetry
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM Ingestion] in telemetry

    arm:B --> T:ps
    iam:R --> L:ps
    ps:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    svc:R --> L:dlp
    dlp:R --> L:mon
    mon:B --> T:chr

package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_partition_expiration_t8

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable BigQuery Continuous Audit Logging and Partition Expiration Guardrails (Tier-8 • Profile F)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_bigquery_table"
  not r.change.after.time_partitioning
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure time_partitioning.expiration_ms for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) on BigQuery Datasets & Tables (Tier-9 • Profile G)
compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for BigQuery within Zero Trust BeyondCorp Ingress & VPC-SC Perimeter Defense. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0.

architecture-beta
    group edge(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress Tier]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[VPC-SC Trust Boundary Enclave]
    group sec(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Posture & SIEM Tier]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Zone] in edge
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor WAF] in edge
    service iap(logos:gcp-iap)[Identity-Aware Proxy] in edge

    service vpcnet(logos:gcp-vpc)[Hierarchical Firewall] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-bigquery)[BigQuery] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Aggregated Audit Sink] in sec
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[Security Command Center] in sec
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM] in sec

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:iap
    iap:B --> T:vpcnet
    vpcnet:R --> L:svc
    svc:R --> L:kms
    svc:B --> T:log
    log:R --> L:scc
    scc:R --> L:chr

opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_cmek_encryption_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) on BigQuery Datasets & Tables (Tier-9 • Profile G)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_bigquery_dataset"
  not r.change.after.default_encryption_configuration
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure default_encryption_configuration.kms_key_name for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Column-Level Access Control via BigQuery Policy Tags and Data Catalog (Tier-9 • Profile H)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for BigQuery within Hardened GKE Autopilot & Binary Authorization Ingress Pipeline. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor & Gateway API]
    group cluster(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Enterprise Autopilot Cluster]
    group supply(logos:gcp-artifact)[Supply Chain & Key Store]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Private DNS] in ingress
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor ML WAF] in ingress
    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[Private Service Connect] in ingress

    service gke(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Shielded Nodes] in cluster
    service svc(logos:gcp-bigquery)[BigQuery] in cluster
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in cluster

    service art(logos:gcp-artifact)[Artifact Registry & Sigstore] in supply
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager] in supply
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Container Threat Detection] in supply

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:psc
    psc:B --> T:gke
    gke:R --> L:svc
    iam:B --> T:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    gke:R --> L:art
    art:R --> L:scc
opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_column_level_security_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Column-Level Access Control via BigQuery Policy Tags and Data Catalog (Tier-9 • Profile H)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_data_catalog_policy_tag"
  not r.change.after.display_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure display_name for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Disable Public Dataset Access and Enforce Authorized Views for Restricted Sharing (Tier-9 • Profile I)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for BigQuery within Mission-Critical Multi-Region Failover & Immutable Cloud Storage. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group routing(logos:gcp-armor)[Global Anycast External ALB]
    group region(logos:gcp-vpc)[Dual-Region Workload Enclave]
    group dr(logos:gcp-gcs)[Immutable Disaster Recovery Vault]

    service alb(logos:gcp-armor)[Global Cloud Load Balancing] in routing
    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Cloud DNS Health Checks] in routing

    service prm(logos:gcp-bigquery)[Primary Service Instance] in region
    service stb(logos:gcp-bigquery)[Secondary Failover Replica] in region
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Dual-Region Key] in region

    service gcs(logos:gcp-gcs)[Immutable Bucket Lock] in dr
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Alert] in dr
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Incident SOAR] in dr

    alb:B --> T:prm
    dns:R --> L:alb
    prm:R --> L:stb
    prm:B --> T:kms
    stb:B --> T:kms
    prm:B --> T:gcs
    prm:R --> L:mon
    mon:R --> L:chr

package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_no_public_access_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Disable Public Dataset Access and Enforce Authorized Views for Restricted Sharing (Tier-9 • Profile I)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_bigquery_dataset_access"
  not r.change.after.special_group
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure special_group for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.

package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_partition_expiration_t9

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable BigQuery Continuous Audit Logging and Partition Expiration Guardrails (Tier-9 • Profile J)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_bigquery_table"
  not r.change.after.time_partitioning
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure time_partitioning.expiration_ms for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_cmek_encryption_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) on BigQuery Datasets & Tables (Tier-10 • Profile K)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_bigquery_dataset"
  not r.change.after.default_encryption_configuration
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure default_encryption_configuration.kms_key_name for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Column-Level Access Control via BigQuery Policy Tags and Data Catalog (Tier-10 • Profile L)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for BigQuery within Data Perimeter & Private Service Connect (PSC) Architecture. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group auth(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access & Org Policy]
    group vpc(logos:gcp-vpc)[Private Service Connect Enclave]
    group audit(logos:gcp-logging)[Centralized Audit & SIEM Sink]

    service caa(logos:gcp-iam)[Context-Aware Access] in auth
    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Constraint] in auth

    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[PSC Endpoint Endpoint] in vpc
    service svc(logos:gcp-bigquery)[BigQuery] in vpc
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS HSM] in vpc

    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Cloud Logging Log Bucket] in audit
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Enterprise SIEM] in audit
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Continuous Compliance] in audit

    caa:R --> L:org
    org:B --> T:psc
    psc:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    svc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:scc

package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_column_level_security_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Column-Level Access Control via BigQuery Policy Tags and Data Catalog (Tier-10 • Profile L)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_data_catalog_policy_tag"
  not r.change.after.display_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure display_name for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Disable Public Dataset Access and Enforce Authorized Views for Restricted Sharing (Tier-10 • Profile M)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for BigQuery within Cloud Security Command Center (SCC) & Automated Incident Remediation. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group detect(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Threat & Misconfig Discovery]
    group event(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Security Notification Bus]
    group remediate(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Automated Eventarc Remediation]

    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Premium Finding Engine] in detect
    service log(logos:gcp-logging)[Audit Log Realtime Stream] in detect
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Detection Engine] in detect

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Security Notification Topic] in event
    service cr(logos:gcp-cloudrun)[Cloud Run Remediation Handler] in event
    service svc(logos:gcp-bigquery)[BigQuery] in event

    service org(logos:gcp-org-policy)[Org Policy Enforcer] in remediate
    service kms(logos:gcp-kms)[Cloud KMS Key Rotation] in remediate
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Monitoring Alert Channel] in remediate

    scc:R --> L:log
    log:R --> L:chr
    chr:B --> T:ps
    ps:R --> L:cr
    cr:B --> T:org
    org:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:kms
    cr:R --> L:mon

package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_no_public_access_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Disable Public Dataset Access and Enforce Authorized Views for Restricted Sharing (Tier-10 • Profile M)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_bigquery_dataset_access"
  not r.change.after.special_group
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure special_group for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enable BigQuery Continuous Audit Logging and Partition Expiration Guardrails (Tier-10 • Profile N)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for BigQuery within Decoupled Enterprise Event Mesh & Cloud Pub/Sub Hardening. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 1.4.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Edge Perimeter & Ingress]
    group messaging(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub Enterprise Mesh]
    group telemetry(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Observability & Audit]

    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor Protection] in ingress
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in ingress

    service ps(logos:gcp-pubsub)[Pub/Sub KMS-Encrypted Topic] in messaging
    service svc(logos:gcp-bigquery)[BigQuery] in messaging
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager Envelope] in messaging

    service dlp(logos:gcp-dlp)[Cloud DLP Automatic Inspection] in telemetry
    service mon(logos:gcp-monitoring)[Cloud Monitoring Metrics] in telemetry
    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle SIEM Ingestion] in telemetry

    arm:B --> T:ps
    iam:R --> L:ps
    ps:R --> L:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    svc:R --> L:dlp
    dlp:R --> L:mon
    mon:B --> T:chr

package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_partition_expiration_t10

default allow = false

# Rule: Enable BigQuery Continuous Audit Logging and Partition Expiration Guardrails (Tier-10 • Profile N)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 1.4, SOC 2 Type II CC6.8, NIST 800-53 CP-9, HITRUST CSF v9.4
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_bigquery_table"
  not r.change.after.time_partitioning
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure time_partitioning.expiration_ms for compliance standard CIS GCP 1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_cmek_encryption_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) on BigQuery Datasets & Tables (Tier-11 • Profile O)
# Compliance: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0, NIST SP 800-53 SC-13, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 3.4, SOC 2 CC6.1
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_bigquery_dataset"
  not r.change.after.default_encryption_configuration
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure default_encryption_configuration.kms_key_name for compliance standard CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Enforce Column-Level Access Control via BigQuery Policy Tags and Data Catalog (Tier-11 • Profile P)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for BigQuery within Hardened GKE Autopilot & Binary Authorization Ingress Pipeline. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 2.1.1.
mermaid:
architecture-beta
    group ingress(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor & Gateway API]
    group cluster(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Enterprise Autopilot Cluster]
    group supply(logos:gcp-artifact)[Supply Chain & Key Store]

    service dns(logos:gcp-dns)[Private DNS] in ingress
    service arm(logos:gcp-armor)[Cloud Armor ML WAF] in ingress
    service psc(logos:gcp-psc)[Private Service Connect] in ingress

    service gke(logos:gcp-gke)[GKE Shielded Nodes] in cluster
    service svc(logos:gcp-bigquery)[BigQuery] in cluster
    service iam(logos:gcp-iam)[Workload Identity] in cluster

    service art(logos:gcp-artifact)[Artifact Registry & Sigstore] in supply
    service sec(logos:gcp-secrets)[Secret Manager] in supply
    service scc(logos:gcp-scc)[SCC Container Threat Detection] in supply

    dns:R --> L:arm
    arm:R --> L:psc
    psc:B --> T:gke
    gke:R --> L:svc
    iam:B --> T:svc
    svc:B --> T:sec
    gke:R --> L:art
    art:R --> L:scc
opa_policy:
package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_column_level_security_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Enforce Column-Level Access Control via BigQuery Policy Tags and Data Catalog (Tier-11 • Profile P)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 2.1.1, NIST SP 800-171, HIPAA 164.312(a)(2)(iv), FedRAMP High
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_data_catalog_policy_tag"
  not r.change.after.display_name
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure display_name for compliance standard CIS GCP 2.1.1", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan

title: Disable Public Dataset Access and Enforce Authorized Views for Restricted Sharing (Tier-11 • Profile Q)
description: Implements enterprise architectural defense for BigQuery within Mission-Critical Multi-Region Failover & Immutable Cloud Storage. Enforces explicit relation mapping across Google Cloud edge ingress, VPC Service Controls perimeter trust boundaries, Cloud KMS HSM customer-managed key encryption, and Security Command Center / Chronicle SIEM governance. Fully mapped to CIS GCP 3.1.4.

    group region(logos:gcp-vpc)[Dual-Region Workload Enclave]

    service chr(logos:gcp-chronicle)[Chronicle Incident SOAR] in dr

package gcp.gcp_bigquery.gcp_bigquery_bigquery_no_public_access_t11

default allow = false

# Rule: Disable Public Dataset Access and Enforce Authorized Views for Restricted Sharing (Tier-11 • Profile Q)
# Compliance: CIS GCP 3.1.4, ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.8.24, PCI-DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1, NIST 800-53 AU-2
deny[msg] {
  r := input.resource_changes[_]
  r.type == "google_bigquery_dataset_access"
  not r.change.after.special_group
  msg := sprintf("Resource %v must configure special_group for compliance standard CIS GCP 3.1.4", [r.address])
}
remediation: Inspect resource in Google Cloud Console or apply Terraform: terraform plan -out=tfplan && terraform apply tfplan
